race.comment: VELOCITE BELLE (10) pushed forward when resuming last time and boxed on to finish 1.1 lengths away in third over 1009m at Yarra Valley. Drawn to enjoy a good run on the speed. Must raise the bar, but she has the talent to test this line-up. LAFARNA (5) is a daughter of Farnan who has won both trials this time in, draws well and gets Blake Shinn, so must be considered. VIXEN VIBES (11) finished 1.1 lengths away in fourth last time out over 1000m at Bendigo. Steps up in journey today and is among the chances. SISTERLY (13) has failed to fill a placing at her last few runs, the latest when sixth, beaten 3 lengths, over 1400m at Sale. Gear change may improve.
